verses.html: 1 As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
verses.text: 1 As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”

verses.html: 2 “Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
verses.text: 2 “Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

verses.html: 3 While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
verses.text: 3 While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,

verses.html: 4 “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
verses.text: 4 “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”

verses.html: 5 Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.
verses.text: 5 Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.

verses.html: 6 Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
verses.text: 6 Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.

verses.html: 7 When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
verses.text: 7 When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.

verses.html: 8 Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
verses.text: 8 Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.

verses.html: 1 And he going out from the temple, one of his disciples says to him, “Teacher, look! What manner of stones and what manner of buildings!”
verses.text: 1 And he going out from the temple, one of his disciples says to him, “Teacher, look! What manner of stones and what manner of buildings!”

verses.html: 2 And Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? A stone upon a stone will certainly not be left here, which will certainly not be torn down.”
verses.text: 2 And Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? A stone upon a stone will certainly not be left here, which will certainly not be torn down.”

verses.html: 3 And he sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew were asking him by themselves,
verses.text: 3 And he sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew were asking him by themselves,

verses.html: 4 “Tell us, when will these things be? And what {is} the sign when all these things are about to be completed?”
verses.text: 4 “Tell us, when will these things be? And what {is} the sign when all these things are about to be completed?”

verses.html: 5 Now Jesus began to say to them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
verses.text: 5 Now Jesus began to say to them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

verses.html: 6 Many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and they will lead many astray.
verses.text: 6 Many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and they will lead many astray.

verses.html: 7 But when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be troubled; it is necessary {for this} to happen, but the end {is} not yet.
verses.text: 7 But when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be troubled; it is necessary {for this} to happen, but the end {is} not yet.

verses.html: 8 For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These things {are} the beginning of birth pains.
verses.text: 8 For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These things {are} the beginning of birth pains.

verses.html: 1 After that, Jesus {and his apprentices} left the temple area. {As they were walking,} one of his apprentices said to him, “Instructor, pay attention to how marvelous these huge blocks of stone in the walls are and how beautiful these structures are!”
verses.text: 1 After that, Jesus {and his apprentices} left the temple area. {As they were walking,} one of his apprentices said to him, “Instructor, pay attention to how marvelous these huge blocks of stone in the walls are and how beautiful these structures are!”

verses.html: 2 Jesus replied, “Look at these impressive structures! Enemies will completely destroy them. They will not leave anything standing.”
verses.text: 2 Jesus replied, “Look at these impressive structures! Enemies will completely destroy them. They will not leave anything standing.”

verses.html: 3 Later, Jesus {and his apprentices} sat down on top of the Mount of Olives in front of the temple. When no one else was with them, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Jesus,
verses.text: 3 Later, Jesus {and his apprentices} sat down on top of the Mount of Olives in front of the temple. When no one else was with them, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Jesus,

verses.html: 4 “Please explain to us when what you have described will happen. Also, {please explain to us} how we can tell when everything that you have described is about to happen.”
verses.text: 4 “Please explain to us when what you have described will happen. Also, {please explain to us} how we can tell when everything that you have described is about to happen.”

verses.html: 5 Jesus started to reply, “Make sure that no one deceives you!
verses.text: 5 Jesus started to reply, “Make sure that no one deceives you!

verses.html: 6 Many people will meet you and say that God has authorized them as he has authorized me. They will say that they are {the Messiah}. {By doing that,} they will deceive many people.
verses.text: 6 Many people will meet you and say that God has authorized them as he has authorized me. They will say that they are {the Messiah}. {By doing that,} they will deceive many people.

verses.html: 7 Whenever people tell you about wars that are happening and about wars that could happen, do not be afraid. Things like that have to happen. However, what I have said about the temple will not yet happen.
verses.text: 7 Whenever people tell you about wars that are happening and about wars that could happen, do not be afraid. Things like that have to happen. However, what I have said about the temple will not yet happen.

verses.html: 8 Further, groups of people will attack each other. Earthquakes will happen in many places. Many people will not have enough food to eat. Those events are like the first pains a pregnant woman feels when she is going to have a child. They are bad, but many more bad things will still happen after them.
